Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Shubhang Dobhal, learned counsel for the
petitioner. 
2. Mr. N. S. Pundir, learned DAG for the State.
3. List on 16.10.2026 in order to enable the State
Counsel to get instructions why pension is not being
paid to the petitioner particularly when he was retired
from service in November, 2025 and if there are some
issues, in such an eventuality, why Authorities are not
paying provisional pension to the petitioner.

Mr. Shubhang Dobhal, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
2. Mr. Prem Prakash Bhatt, learned Brief 
Holder for the State.
3. On the previous date, the learned State 
Counsel was directed to get the instructions. The 
instructions are still awaited.
4. The petitioner retired on 30.11.2025, but the 
retiral dues have not been released so far.
5. It appears to be a great inaction on the part
of the concerned Officer.
6. Put up this matter on 05.11.2026, at 3:00 PM 
so that the learned State Counsel may apprise 
whether the pensionary benefits have been 
released or not.
